objective: Freeze independent cohorts, exact non-economic denominators, outcome firewall, causal structural gates, descriptive diagnostics and later execution requirements using synthetic tests only
summary: Created immutable protocol/schema/arithmetic helpers and a deterministic machine-readable protocol artifact. The canonical control roster is Charter-bound to 153 trade_id identities; current CSV bytes and rows were not accessed. Controls retain all PIT_UNIVERSE/CONTROL lifecycles without label or outcome filtering. Zero-denominator results remain explicitly undefined. No numerical selectivity boundary or economic conclusion is authorized. Ruff and all 437 synthetic tests pass; all seven existing exit-brain source modules remain unchanged.
north_star_effect: Preserves scientific validity by preregistering behavioral measurement and causal failure gates before empirical work, without confusing selectivity with profitability or granting exit authority.

cohorts.F: A intersect pre-existing canonical control roster

implementation.denominator_policy: A is frozen independently before candidate evaluation; at least one full post-entry completed snapshot and declared causal coverage required. All 153 control identities must be accounted, but |F| is the actual eligible control denominator. Missing coverage is not a negative candidate result, and loss after eligibility fails closed. No outcome/candidate-based inclusion or censoring.

primary_metrics.trigger_before_memory_incidence: lifecycles with pre-memory raw trigger, including never-memory, divided by A

implementation.zero_denominator: value=null, status=UNDEFINED_ZERO_DENOMINATOR; never silently zero or perfect specificity
implementation.firewall: Allowlisted control projection before reading values, exact typed diagnostic schema, unknown fields rejected. Outcome and unproven posthoc label columns are denied. No historical exit_time/exit_reason/holding_hours may set evaluation exposure.
implementation.timing: Fractional UTC hours for memory-to-candidate in E, entry-to-memory in B, entry-to-candidate in E. Count/min/Q25/median/Q75/P90/max with linear (n-1)*p interpolation; empty distributions have count 0 and null statistics. No eligibility dependency.
implementation.episodes: Generic episode count at candidate; raw triggers strictly before latch; raw triggers strictly before memory including all raw for never-memory; same-time rejections separately; repeated raw deterioration strictly after candidate; one-shot invariants.
implementation.contexts: Causally available RISK_ON/TRANSITION/RISK_OFF only, unavailable explicit. Candidate counts by memory/trigger regime; incidence denominators by entry regime or conditional memory regime only. No candidate-time-only denominator. Symbol counts/incidence and all-rank cumulative concentration shares are descriptive, not economic rankings.
implementation.invariant_semantics: Candidate equals the first generic latch, strictly after memory, and a recorded raw candidate; no more than one emission, no lifecycle boundary violation, no missing snapshot evidence. Protocol validators audit recorded chronology without modifying or replacing the generic state machine.
implementation.duplicate_semantics: Exact lifecycle transport copies deterministically deduplicate before accounting; conflicting copies fail closed. Strict post-normalization ledger validation rejects repeated lifecycle or trade_id identities. Raw event transport timestamps deduplicate; duplicate emitted candidate events still fail one-shot validation.
implementation.interpretation: Protocol PASS is not selectivity PASS. No near-universal/nontrivially-selective numerical cutoffs are authorized. Later structurally valid measurements may be SELECTIVITY_OBSERVABLE, while CONTROL_DISCRIMINATION_UNRESOLVED awaits governed review. Empty populations and structural violations do not qualify as evidence of selectivity.
implementation.later_execution_boundary: Next task requires its own admission and exact source/window/year/coverage/lifecycle/regime manifest. The historical control CSV and 4H artifact remain unopened here. Observed-through timestamps must come from authorized causal evaluation/online lifecycle notification, not imported eventual exits. No actual empirical executor is included in this protocol task.
